_comment: Per-modality cost of turning the raw IEMOCAP stream into SeMA input features. extract_gflops = units x per-unit extractor GFLOPs (0 = raw sensor stream, no extractor); extract_ms = measured single-sample extraction time (raw file read + extractor) on an idle NVIDIA L40. Used only for reporting end-to-end GFLOPs and estimated extraction time; ARC prices every modality equally.
